Stored Replicates of a Bootstrap

Source: R/bootstrap_objects.R
StatmodBootstrap.Rd

One entry of the bootstrap collection of a fit: the coefficients of the refitted replicates and the record of how they were obtained. statmod_bootstrap() returns it, and coef() on it returns the matrix of replicates.

Usage

StatmodBootstrap(
  coefficients = NULL,
  hyper = NULL,
  n = integer(0),
  resample = resample_method(),
  refit = character(0),
  random = character(0),
  status = integer(0),
  seed = list(),
  fingerprint = integer(0)
)

Value

coef() on an entry returns the matrix of replicates, and print() returns the entry invisibly. The class itself has no constructor to call.

Details

The properties are

coefficients

a matrix with one row per replicate and one column per coordinate, in the order of coef(fit, readable = FALSE);

hyper

a matrix of the hyperparameters of each replicate, with refit = "full", and NULL otherwise;

n, resample, refit

the number of replicates, the resample_method and the refit;

random

how the random effects were treated: "redrawn" or "none";

status

an integer for every draw of the stream up to the last replicate kept: 0 for a replicate that was kept, 1 for an error, 2 for a mode error above mode_error_limit() and 3 for a coefficient that is not identified;

seed

a list with the state of .Random.seed at the start of the stream and after the last draw that was kept, from which an extension continues;

fingerprint

the coefficients and hyperparameters of the fit that the replicates belong to.

See also

add_bootstrap(), statmod_bootstrap(), bootstrap_vcov().

Examples

set.seed(1)
dd <- data.frame(x = runif(60))
dd$y <- 1 + 2 * dd$x + rnorm(60, sd = 0.4)
fit <- statmod(y ~ x, distributions7::gaussian1_distrib(), dd)
fit <- add_bootstrap(fit, n = 20, resample = case_resample())
entry <- statmod_bootstrap(fit, resample = case_resample())
dim(coef(entry))
#> [1] 20  3
